description: Photovoltaic power production estimation and forecast on Belgian grid (Near real-time) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Intraday forecast, day-ahead and week-ahead forecast of photovoltaic power capacity on the Belgian grid. The values are updated every quarter-hour. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Power generation. Its keywords are Production, Wind, Forecast, Near real-time. The portal shows 2026-05-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
